news.title: Ethereum’s zkAPI brings privacy-preserving API payments to mainnet
news.summary: Ethereum’s zkAPI is now live on mainnet, turning an earlier zero-knowledge API payment proposal into a working implementation for private, prepaid access.

news.title: NEAR Intents says its identified the hacker, gives 48-hour ultimatum
news.summary: “We have identified you, sir,” NEAR Intents general manager Alex Shevchenko said on Friday after the protocol was hacked for $3.8 million.

news.title: SEC moves to clear custody hurdle for advisers offering crypto
news.summary: Custody requirements have kept some investment advisers from offering certain crypto to clients, a regulatory hurdle the SEC’s proposal could remove.

news.title: Ethereum Foundation launches zkAPI to let users pay for AI models without revealing identity
news.summary: Users deposit funds into an Ethereum vault and authorize spending with zero-knowledge proofs, so the API provider can't link requests to a payer.

news.title: China warns foreign spies about crypto, Singapore dominates Asia: Asia Express
news.summary: Singapore’s crypto economy grows 55%, South Korea set to make crypto market makers legal, and Chinese spy ministry warns would-be foreign spies it’s watching the blockchain.

news.title: Evernorth clears shareholder vote ahead of Nasdaq debut with 473M XRP treasury
news.summary: Evernorth expects to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN after its SPAC merger closes, with an XRP treasury worth roughly $710 million at current prices.

news.title: Trump to host 3rd ‘exclusive’ memecoin event amid corruption claims
news.summary: The president is scheduled to appear at his golf club in Washington, DC, at a Nov. 22 dinner for his top 185 memecoin holders, following similar events in May 2025 and April 2026.

news.title: SEC proposes framework allowing investment advisers, funds to self-custody crypto
news.summary: SEC proposed a crypto framework for investment advisers & funds, allowing self-custody in some cases & state trust companies as custodians.

news.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody rules for investment advisers and funds
news.summary: The regulator issued a proposed rule for custody, marking a swan song for its inaugural Crypto Task Force chief, Commissioner Hester Peirce, who exits this week.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Hyperliquid Policy Center, Circle press EU on perps and stablecoin reserves in MiCA review
news.summary: Hyperliquid's policy group wants perps under MiFID II, while Circle targets MiCA's bank deposit floor in filings to the European Commission's MiCA review.

news.title: Another Trump memecoin dinner advertised for token's top investors
news.summary: The company managing the memecoin calls the November event the "most exclusive dinner in the world."

news.title: 50,000 Europeans call on EU to ease stablecoin rewards restrictions in MiCA review
news.summary: A 50,000-letter campaign is pressing Brussels to rethink stablecoin rewards as EU central banks seek broader changes to MiCA’s stablecoin rules.

news.title: Illinois will postpone implementation of crypto tax following lawsuit
news.summary: State officials agreed to delay the 0.2% crypto tax for six months after lawsuits and industry pushback claimed the bill was rushed through the legislature.

news.title: Ethereum staking reward burn proposal EIP-8363 pulled from Hegota upgrade
news.summary: Co-author Jérôme de Tychey said industry participants and core contributors convinced him a scoping process was the wrong venue for an issuance change.

news.title: New York, Wyoming regulators sign pact to coordinate crypto oversight
news.summary: The agreement will allow the two state regulators to share supervisory information, streamline licensing reviews and coordinate examinations and enforcement actions involving digital asset firms.

news.title: Bitcoin fights for local uptrend as US bond yields drop from new 24-year highs
news.summary: US bond yields fell sharply around Thursday’s Wall Street open as Bitcoin price action sought to preserve a local trend of higher lows.

news.title: NEAR Intents suffers $3.8M exploit after assistance with Bitget breach
news.summary: The platform said it will compensate users affected by the hack, which stemmed from a bug that affected deposits and withdrawals.

news.title: Evernorth shareholders approve $1 billion XRP treasury deal, clearing path to Nasdaq debut
news.summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. II shareholders approved the Evernorth merger. The XRP treasury company expects to hold ~473M XRP.

news.title: Crypto for Advisors: The CLARITY Act failed, but the rules came anyway
NEAR Intents hit by $3.8 million exploit as crypto's rough year of hacks continues
news.summary: The popular cross-chain trading system said it will reimburse losses after a bug affected deposits and withdrawals across several networks.

news.title: NEAR Intents halts services after $3.8 million exploit, promises full compensation
news.summary: NEAR Intents patched the contract flaw, but deposits and withdrawals on 11 networks remain disrupted.

news.title: Bitget’s $388M hack pushes Q3 crypto security losses past $1B
news.summary: Crypto security losses reached $1.26 billion in Q3 across 247 incidents, with September alone accounting for roughly $769 million.

news.title: LATAM stablecoin liquidity may depend on few providers, investor says
news.summary: Researchers in a Latin American stablecoin ecosystem report warned “fragility in the system is concentrated in its thinnest layer,” with just 16 of 494 companies focused primarily on wholesale liquidity, treasury and credit.

news.title: Stablecoins can drain from banks and nations at lightning speed
news.summary: Highly liquid and settling 24/7, stablecoins can leave banks and countries at lightning speed. But whether stablecoins are a risk — or an opportunity — depends on your perspective.

news.title: Robinhood Wallet integrates Arcus RFQ system for stock token swaps
news.summary: Robinhood Wallet adds Arcus as a routing provider for Stock Token swaps, giving eligible users access to more than 190 tokens.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs’ 9-day, $3 billion inflow streak comes to an end as $149 million exits the funds
news.summary: Meanwhile, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs saw $59.6 million in net outflows on Wednesday, led by $26.6 million exiting Fidelity's FETH fund.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin posts tentative gains as rates drop ahead of Friday's jobs report
news.summary: The euro is losing ground versus the greenback as spiking French bond yields revive memories of the European sovereign debt crisis.

news.title: Illinois agrees to six-month delay of crypto tax as industry continues court battle
news.summary: Both sides agreed the 0.2% tax should be put off until July 1, if the court approves the deal, which will let the state and industry focus on the legal dispute.

news.title: Crypto lost $1.26 billion in hacks while bitcoin bulls enjoyed a monster quarter
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 1, 2026

news.title: Lloyds, Visa settle $750,000 using USDC in live cross-border pilot
news.summary: Lloyds used USDC to settle $750,000 of payment obligations with Visa during a seven-day live cross-border pilot.

news.title: Synthetic tokenized stocks are bad for American investors
news.summary: U.S. markets are the envy of the world because investors trust that whoever owns a share owns it fully, writes Aaron Kaplan, founder of Promethum. The synthetic models cheapens that trust, shortchanges U.S. investors, and undercuts the issuer-led capital markets model.

news.title: Tokenized assets don’t always mirror traditional markets, Dune finds
news.summary: Dune found that tokenized markets show different trading patterns from traditional markets, with RWA value reaching $34.5 billion.

news.title: Bitcoin kicks off new quarter in the old $82,000-$85,000 price range
news.summary: Prices briefly topped $85,000 on Wednesday after weaker-than-expected U.S. inflation cooled bets on Fed rate hikes, But bulls couldn’t hold the move and spot ETFs didn’t help.

news.title: Bitcoin trapped below $86K as PCE changes cloud inflation reading
news.summary: Bitcoin erased its post-PCE gains as analysts cautioned that methodology changes complicated the lower-than-expected inflation reading.

news.title: Binance’s EU services face scrutiny over licensing exemption: Report
news.summary: EU regulators are reportedly examining Binance’s use of a MiCA exemption to serve customers as ESMA seeks stronger enforcement powers.

news.title: Citigroup raises 12-month bitcoin target to $113,000 as ETF inflows resume
news.summary: Citi also raised its 12-month target for ether from from $2,240 to $3,028.

news.title: Chainalysis beats most Celsius claims, but ‘audit’ lawsuit survives
news.summary: Chainalysis still faces an aiding-and-abetting claim over Celsius’ disputed $3.3 billion audit after a judge dismissed 15 other claims.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $6.3B in Q3 as BTC price rises nearly 43%
news.summary: Bitcoin gained 42.71% in Q3, its best third-quarter performance since 2017, as US spot ETFs attracted $6.34 billion in net inflows.

news.title: MetaMask security incident forces Ethereum staking exits, no funds at risk
news.summary: An Ethereum security researcher estimates about 0.36 ETH in rewards was diverted, while precautionary exits cover validators holding roughly 523,000 ETH.

news.title: Bitcoin think tank questions MSCI’s ‘invisible committee’ over Strategy, Metaplanet rule
news.summary: A Bitcoin Policy Institute paper says MSCI’s proposed “non-operating company” rule could remove Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes and may have roots in an earlier crypto treasury review.

news.title: Dogecoin gets DeFi testnet as DogeOS bets miners will eventually secure its apps
news.summary: DogeOS wants to turn DOGE into more than a payments and speculation asset, but its applications still rely on selected operators rather than Dogecoin miners.

news.title: Crypto hacks top $768M in September, worst month of 2026
news.summary: The $388 million Bitget breach and $320 million Liquid Network exploit accounted for most of September’s losses, though more than $270 million from the latter was later returned.

news.title: Bitcoin's soft-inflation pop to $85,500 fades as bond yields refuse to fall
news.summary: A cooler-than-expected PCE report sent bitcoin briefly above $85,000 on Wednesday. Treasury yields held near their highest since 2002 and the gains drained away.

news.title: CFTC seeks to define event contracts as swaps amid prediction market fight
news.summary: The classification could assist the CFTC’s claim that it has exclusive federal jurisdiction over event contracts offered on regulated prediction markets.

news.title: MetaMask exits Ethereum validators amid undisclosed security incident
news.summary: MetaMask said it is investigating the threat internally and said it has found no immediate threat to its wallets.

news.title: Clarity Act’s failure gave crypto ‘faster’ regulatory wins, Bitwise CIO says
news.summary: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan says Clarity’s defeat left crypto with fewer restrictions and faster SEC action.

news.title: Standard Chartered sees Ethena’s USDe reaching $40B, ENA hitting $2
news.summary: The bank also expects Ethena’s ENA token to rise roughly sevenfold to $2 by the end of 2028 as USDe scales and token buybacks increase.

news.title: CFTC secures over $30 million judgment against defendants in Fundsz fraud case
news.summary: The CFTC secured a win in court after the agency said two defendants participated in a crypto scheme that they then tried to walk back.

news.title: Base launches Cobalt upgrade with conditional transactions and new B20 asset functions
news.summary: Base has launched Cobalt, adding conditional transactions and new functions for assets issued under its B20 standard.

news.title: DogeOS launches testnet to bring EVM smart contracts to Dogecoin
news.summary: DogeOS launched a public testnet for its zero-knowledge rollup bringing EVM smart contracts to Dogecoin, with DOGE used for gas fees.

news.title: White House weighs new CFTC event contract rules in growing prediction market power struggle
news.summary: The White House is weighing two proposed rules from the CFTC tied to prediction markets as the agency seeks to assert its jurisdiction.

news.title: Crypto industry gave $8 million to Clarity Act lobbyists who didn't close the deal
news.summary: In the first half of this year, the sector poured millions into lobbying, with most of it tied to pushing the U.S. market structure bill to a goal it never reached.

news.title: Bitcoin steadies as soft PCE cools October Fed rate hike bets
news.summary: Core PCE rose just 0.2% in August, easing pressure for an October Fed hike. Bitcoin trades near $83,700 as rising Treasury yields cap gains.

news.title: Open USD takes on Tether, Circle with a different stablecoin model that's 'building money'
news.summary: The “overwhelming majority” of Open Standard’s equity will be distributed over time to partners based on how much they help grow the stablecoin, CEO Zach Abrams said.

news.title: U.S. CFTC seeks event contract definitions that may defy states' gambling claims
news.summary: As it battles with states over prediction markets, the CFTC sent two related rules on swaps definitions for White House review.

news.summary: FCA opens crypto authorization window, setting a Feb. 28, 2027 deadline as UK firms face fresh vetting under new regime.

news.title: Cardano tapped by Brazil’s state oil giant to track cleaner jet fuel and diesel
news.summary: Petrobras is testing the blockchain in two research projects aimed at preventing emissions benefits from being counted twice and tracing fuel data across production and use.

news.title: Standard Chartered sees over 600% upside for ENA, expects USDe to hit $40 billion by 2028
news.summary: Standard Chartered forecasts ENA will reach $2 by the end of 2028 as USDe scales eightfold and buybacks reshape the token's value.

news.summary: Weeks after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate, crypto advocacy group Stand With Crypto rolled out its first round of Senate endorsements.

news.summary: Three transfers pushed about 15% of the stolen ZEC into Ironwood, where payments hide their senders, recipients and amounts.

news.title: The SEC Is finally modernizing transfer-agent rules. Wall Street must not repeat the ‘paperwork crisis’
news.summary: If ownership data is split across a token wrapper, a special-purpose vehicle (SPV), a broker’s internal ledger and a transfer agent's off-chain database, we are setting the stage for a Paperwork Crisis for the blockchain age, argues Fairmint’s Joris Delanoue.

news.title: OpenAI, Google and Meta pledge independent AI safety audits under voluntary White House deal
news.summary: Six companies signed a safety pact covering hacking and biological threats, with no penalties or deadline for putting the checks in place.

news.title: Metaplanet directors push back against shareholder fury over a controversial executive payout plan
news.summary: Independent directors cite management’s financial risk and restructuring role, but leave questions about Gerovich’s exercised shares and MMXX Ventures unanswered.

news.summary: Crypto prices rose early Wednesday after better-than-forecast inflation data, but gave up those gains as interest rates continued to surge.
